maddeler.e:
نندلق (form VII)
# نَنْدَلِقُ (nandaliqu) /nan.da.li.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَلَقَ (indalaqa)
# نَنْدَلِقَ (nandaliqa) /nan.da.li.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَلَقَ (indalaqa)
# نَنْدَلِقْ (nandaliq) /nan.da.liq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَلَقَ (indalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
